paragraphs.text: 将 DeepSeek Harness 桥接到已配置其它 Harness Agent 的项目。支持 CodeBuddy / Codex / OpenCode / Claude Code / ...
> This project is implemented by DeepSeek Harness.
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that bridges projects already configured for Claude Code, CodeBuddy Code,
OpenCode, Codex, Pi, Gemini CLI, or Cursor into DeepSeek Harness, so existing skills, commands, memo
ry, and hooks continue to work without any migration.
To install from a checkout of this repository, build it first: `pnpm install && pnpm build && dsh pl
Complete example projects for each agent tool are available in `examples/` (`claude-code`, `codebudd
y-code`, `opencode`, `codex`, `pi`, `gemini-cli`, `cursor`); open one as the session workspace to ob
serve its skills, memory, and hooks being bridged.
Assets are discovered per session workspace, from project and user-level locations. All bridges are
enabled by default and can be configured or disabled from any patch layer:

| Agent tool | Skills / commands | Memory | Hooks | Permissions | MCP | Guide |
| :--- | :---: | :--

- Usage guide (install and verify, shared behaviors, per-tool deep dives): `docs/guides/`
- Example

projects, one per bridged agent tool: `examples/`
